remarks: Meticulously maintained house in an ideal location. Classic details have been preserved as the home has been expanded and remodeled. The eat-in-kitchen is timeless with marble and stainless countertops and top-of-the-line appliances. The dining room, living room and family room are filled with windows and french doors looking out to a secluded flagstone patio and professionally manicured lawn. The floor plan is flexible to meet owners needs and includes spacious rooms with high ceilings, as well as a private office space. Hardwood floors throughout. Located on .74 acres close to town, parks and other amenities.
